title: get_local_mouse_position() does not return the correct position through SubViewport
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.6.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (16 threads) - 48.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

For a local multiplayer game, I use player viewports that use scenario viewports' worlds so I can comfortably have multiple player views on scenarios.

For that purpose, I use 1-4 player sub viewports arranged in the screen, each using the `world_2d` of scenario viewports where each player is in.

For aiming at the mouse, I thought I could use `player.get_local_mouse_position()`, but that does not appear to work when the player is in the mentioned scenario viewport, visible in the player viewport.

Please see the attached project where the `UsedViewport` corresponds to the player viewport mentioned above and the `OriginalViewport` corresponds to the scenario viewport. I expected the `%Sprite2D.get_local_mouse_position()` call to return the position of the mouse in the `Sprite2D`'s local coordinates.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run Project
2. Move the mouse over the Game window
3. See in the debug output that `get_local_mouse_position()` is not correctly calculated for the `Sprite2D` in the `OriginalViewport` viewport whose `world_2d` is used in the `UsedViewport`, but it is correctly calculated for the `Camera2D` in the `UsedViewport`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[viewport-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22501757/viewport-test.zip)
